name: media-resource-manager
description: Media Resource Manager - Amazon CDK application for managing EC2 workstations with Amazon DCV

scripts.version-sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const root=require('./package.json');const fp='frontend/package.json';const fe=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fp));fe.version=root.version;fs.writeFileSync(fp,JSON.stringify(fe,null,2)+'\n');console.log('Synced version to frontend:',root.version)"
scripts.version: npm run version-sync && cd frontend && npm version $npm_package_version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version
scripts.security:cfn-nag: npm run build && cdk synth --quiet && cfn_nag_scan --input-path cdk.out
scripts.security:semgrep: semgrep scan --config auto lambda lib frontend/src
